units.source_text: 轮到大竹七段下黑131时，中间遇上午休，

en.t: When it was Otake 7-dan's turn to play Black 131, the lunch break came in the middle of his move,

units.source_text: 他沉思了一小时十五分，于下午二时一度抓起棋子，

en.t: he thought deeply for one hour and fifteen minutes, and at two o'clock in the afternoon he once picked up a stone,

units.source_text: 又“唉”地叹了一声，再次思考了一分钟才落子。

en.t: then sighed again with an Ah, thought for another minute, and only then placed it on the board.
